Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. A "by" condition can't be met if only some of the required actions are performed. The conditions for this [Main] effect require you to pay 2 cost.
Card Q&A.q: Can I pay just 1 cost for this card's [Main] effect?

Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. If you don't pay 2 cost, the part after "then" in this card's [Main] effect won't let this Digimon attack.
Card Q&A.q: Can I process the part of the effect after "then" in this card's [Main] effect without meeting the "by" condition?
